title: Enforce live authorization on procurement receipt operations
description: Stage3 priority: implement a core operational integrity gap through existing business APIs/services. Preserve permissions, audit, original evidence and existing layers; no report, UI polish, Agent or production operations.
acceptance_criteria: Each existing inbound receipt read/create/update/submit/approve/cancel/delete/movements route must fail closed for missing/disabled/unmapped user or missing existing stock-in module permission. Apply existing actual supplier/warehouse/customer scope rules; linked procurement owning customer cannot expose a customer outside current user scope. Do not invent new permissions or treat null identity as administrative. A legitimately unlinked stocking receipt remains allowed only to existing authorized inbound operators.

Check stored and requested receipt/source ownership before update/delete/status or movement mutation, recheck live authorization and source within approval/reversal transaction. Reuse existing inventory business service for all writes; denied caller cannot change quantities,cost,movements,source status or consume a document number where validation should precede generation. Scope paged lists and detail/movement read consistently, avoid leaking foreign identifiers and retain audit.

Meaningful tests prove denied/unmapped/disabled caller, authorized inbound operator, foreign owning customer, source link change on edit, access revocation between reads and approval/cancel, no mutation on denial, and authorized quantity/cost/reversal behavior using genuine HTTP identities. Repair existing legacy fixtures only by genuine seeded authorized test users, retain every business assertion; safe Release and real SQL tests required.

Real SQL fixtures must require exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance, IntegratedSecurity and NEWERP_AUTOTEST prefix before access. Create only a new GUID-owned database, reject existing database, never drop/reset any database or read production settings. Use SQL generated identities, fail wrong-target guards before access, retain complete logs. Execute relevant unit and safe Release build/test plus real SQL scenarios; build completion does not mean stage acceptance.
implementation_evidence:
StockInController.GetPaged/GetById/GetMovements query unscoped receipts. Create/Update/Approve/Cancel have no current-user menu/data-scope checks; inherited Submit/Delete are likewise unscoped. ERP342/344 quantity/source rules validate business identity of linked order but not caller authorization; StockOut has a live scope repair9733b69 and inbound counterpart still missing.
2026-10-08 safe validation1 failed49 old inventory/cost/fulfillment tests due to direct controller construction without authenticated HTTP context and unseeded supplier/warehouse. Full log .ai/logs/ERP-352-validation-1.log preserved. Precisely authorize PurchaseStockInCostTests and a reusable real privileged-user/master-data fixture plus missing-context unauthorized regression. Preserve all original stock/cost/quantity assertions; do not bypass authorization or loosen source checks. Independent local implementation proceeds while provider Insufficient Balance remains accurately blocked.
